user.title: Add a TV or media box
user.description: Pick the type of device you want to control.

lg_webos.title: LG WebOS TV
lg_webos.description: Enter the IP/hostname of the TV. MAC is optional but required to turn the TV on when it's fully off (Wake-on-LAN).

pair.title: Pairing with TV
pair.description: Look at the TV at {host} and accept the pairing prompt. Then press SUBMIT here.

apple_tv_scan.title: Discover Apple TV
apple_tv_scan.description: Pick the Apple TV you want to add.

apple_tv_pair_companion.title: Pair Companion protocol
apple_tv_pair_companion.description: A 4-digit PIN should be showing on the screen of {device}. Enter it here to pair the Companion protocol (used for remote control and power).

data.pin: PIN shown on the Apple TV

apple_tv_pair_airplay.title: Pair AirPlay protocol
apple_tv_pair_airplay.description: A second 4-digit PIN should be showing on {device}. Enter it here to pair the AirPlay protocol (used for volume and metadata).

data.pin: PIN shown on the Apple TV

samsung.title: Samsung Tizen TV
samsung.description: Enter the IP/hostname and MAC of the Samsung TV. When you submit, the TV will show a popup — accept it within 30 seconds to authorise this integration. MAC is required for Wake-on-LAN.

error.pair_refused: Pairing was refused. Try again with the new PIN shown on screen.
error.no_client_key: Pairing succeeded but no client key was returned.

abort.device_type_not_implemented: This device type isn't implemented yet.
abort.no_devices_found: No Apple TVs were found on the network.

init.title: Source preferences
init.description: Pick which sources (inputs and apps) appear in the media_player picker. Leave empty to show all of them.{note}
